full_judgment: This appeal is directed against a judgment of reversal arising out of a suit for specific performance of contract. The plaintiff stated that the defendant Nos. 1-4 contracted to sale the suit land to him for a consideration of Taka 2,500/. He paid a sum of Taka 2,300/ as advance and promised to pay the balance when the defendants would execute a kabala. The defendants 1-4 executed a bainapatra Ext. 1 on 16-6-67, but upon their failure to execute the kabala the plaintiff was obliged to file the suit.
